scope: registered before reading converted F4 HDF5; same physical operators across coarse, medium, fine, half_dt, and half_save
mass_semantics: native MassFluid and typed identity mass; continuum mass is a separate ledger; no normalization

source_destination.source_identity: initial_type=3 and native mk mapped through generated XML mkfluid-to-mk binding
source_destination.destination_regions: explicit physical source boxes plus the derived fixed inter-column gap for oblique_finite_columns
source_destination.quantity: raw active native mass by source and destination region, with unnormalized source mass fractions only as derived values

contact_spread_recontact.contact: any source particle enters its fixed physical target box expanded by fixed_physical_tolerance_m
contact_spread_recontact.spread: maximum axis-aligned extent of each source identity group over active particles
contact_spread_recontact.recontact: a false contact interval followed by a later true contact; right-censored if absent
contact_spread_recontact.diagnostic: repeat contact/spread/recontact using max(3*dp_m, 0.02 m), reported only as resolution-dependent diagnostic

transport_plane.finite_drop_pool: downstream x boundary of the fixed pool box
transport_plane.oblique_finite_columns: midpoint x plane between fixed left and right column boxes
transport_plane.crossing: identity-resolved signed crossings; first passage and mass-weighted residence are right-censored when unobserved

lifecycle.missing_particle_policy: retain typed identity and valid mask; report unknown position/state mass separately; never infer spill or redistribution

qualification_boundary: operator output is actual reference evidence; this file grants neither Q-I nor Q-N nor production eligibility
